prompt.text:
A box contains 23 red buttons and 27 blue buttons. If one of these buttons is selected at random,
what is the probability of selecting a red button? (Express your answer as a decimal or fraction,
not as a percent.)

What is an $x$-coordinate of an $x$-intercept of the graph of $y=4 ( x - 13 ) ( x+5 ) ( x$ +
1 ) in the $xy$-plane?

Before liftoff, one of a space shuttle'$s$ solid rocket boosters contained 489,000 kilograms $(\mathrm{kg})$ of
propellant. Exactly 23 seconds after liftoff, $374,046 \mathrm{kg}$ of this propellant remained. On average,
how much propellant, in $\mathrm{kg}$, did this solid rocket booster burn each second after liftoff?

Circle A in the $xy$-plane has the equation $( x+8 ) 2+( y - 8 ) 2=4$, Circle $B$
has the same center as circle A. The radius of circle $B$ is two times the radius of circle A. The

equation defining circle $B$ in the $xy$-plane is $( x+8 ) 2+( y - 8 ) 2=k$, where
$k$ is a constant. What is the value of $k$?
The function $f$ is defined by $f ( x )=20 x$. For what value of $x$ is $f ( x )=140$?

The function $g$ is defined as $g ( x )=2x-4/(x+13)(x-5)$, and $g ( a )=\frac{1}{4}$, where $a$
is a constant, what is the value of $a$?

The function $g$ is defined by $g ( x )=1/m x+21$, where $m$ is an integer constant and
$14 \le m \le 17$. For the graph of $y=g ( x ) - 9$ in the $xy$-plane, what is the $x$-coordinate of
a possible $x$-intercept?
